situation: I'm Tom, a freelance email copywriter. I signed up to skincare brand Fern & Salt last week: the welcome email is a single 10% code, with none of the seaweed-sourcing story from their product pages. I want to pitch the founder, Olivia; my last welcome sequence, for Kind Botanics, lifted first-order rate from 3.1% to 5.4%.
reply:
Subject: Fern & Salt's welcome email

Hi Olivia,
I signed up last week and your welcome email is a single 10% code, with none of the seaweed-sourcing story that makes your product pages so good. I write welcome sequences for skincare brands; the last one, for Kind Botanics, lifted first-order rate from 3.1% to 5.4%. Want a two-line idea for yours? If it's not relevant, a 'no' is genuinely useful.
Tom

situation: J'anime des ateliers de céramique à Lyon. Je veux proposer une collab à Claire, une créatrice Instagram (30k abonnés) sur les loisirs créatifs lents, qui a posté une vidéo sur le tricot comme pause anti-écran. Trois créatrices lyonnaises ont déjà filmé une séance chez nous (la dernière vidéo a fait 80 000 vues), et je peux lui offrir un atelier pour elle et une amie.
reply: Bonjour Claire, ta vidéo sur le tricot comme pause anti-écran m'a vraiment parlé, c'est exactement l'esprit de nos ateliers de céramique à Lyon. Trois créatrices lyonnaises ont déjà filmé une séance chez nous, la dernière vidéo a fait 80 000 vues. J'ai une idée simple, avec un atelier offert pour toi et une amie. Je te l'explique en deux lignes ?
note: Le « pourquoi toi » d'abord, une preuve chiffrée, puis une toute petite demande.

situation: Emailed Grace, head of People at a 200-person company, about our onboarding software a week ago. No reply. We just published a free two-page checklist on cutting first-week IT tickets, based on 40 mid-size rollouts, and I want to follow up once with it.
reply: Hi Grace, bumping this with one more thing: we just published a two-page checklist on cutting first-week IT tickets, based on 40 mid-size rollouts. It's attached and free to use whether or not we ever talk. No pressure on the original ask.
note: Follow-up 1 adds value instead of 'just checking in'. One more after a week, then stop.

situation: 我做餐饮门店的排班软件销售，给一家连锁火锅店的IT负责人郑先生发过一封冷邮件、跟进过一次。今天他回了一句：“你们已经发了好几次了，别再给我发了。”
reply: 好的，郑先生，已经把您从我们所有的发送名单里移除了，打扰了。
note: 对方语气冲，就只回一次：确认已删除、道一句歉，不解释、不再推销，然后真的从所有名单里删掉。

situation: I'm a backend engineer looking for my next job. Rachel Okafor, an engineering manager at Quillstack, wrote a great LinkedIn post about moving their job queue off Postgres; they have no open roles listed. At Parcelwise I led a similar queue migration that cut p95 job latency from 40 seconds to 3.
reply: Hi Rachel, your post on moving Quillstack's job queue off Postgres was the clearest write-up of that trade-off I've read this year. I'm a backend engineer; at Parcelwise I led a similar queue migration that cut p95 job latency from 40 seconds to 3. Is your team hiring backend engineers in the next few months? A quick yes or no is genuinely helpful.
note: A job search is still cold outreach: prove you read her work, give one number, and ask a yes/no question instead of asking for a call.

situation: I coach an under-10s football team, the Riverside Robins. We need new kits, about £600 for 18 kids. There's a family bakery on our high street, Crumb & Co, and the owner Sophie posts a lot about supporting local things. We play at Harlow Rec on Saturday mornings, just up the road from her, and last season's sponsor, Park Lane Cycles, said the Saturday parents were their best local advertising. I want to DM her on Instagram.
reply: Hi Sophie, I coach the Riverside Robins, the under-10s who play on Harlow Rec every Saturday morning, just up the road from you. We're looking for a local sponsor for new kits this season: £600 covers shirts for all 18 kids, with Crumb & Co on the front. Last season's sponsor, Park Lane Cycles, told us the Saturday crowd of parents was their best local advertising. Would you be open to it? A no is completely fine too.
note: Exact cost, what she gets, one piece of proof, one yes/no question. The easy no matters more when you're asking a neighbourhood business.

situation: I'm Sam and I run a free volunteer repair café in Easton, Bristol; we've fixed 1,240 items since January, mostly lamps, kettles and toasters, and I have month-by-month numbers. Amy Clarke at the Harbourside Herald wrote last week about households binning broken appliances because repair costs more than buying new. I want to email her.
reply:
Subject: 1,240 things Bristol didn't throw away

Hi Amy,
Your piece last week on people binning appliances because repair costs more than new is exactly what we see every month. We run a free volunteer repair café in Easton and have fixed 1,240 items since January, mostly lamps, kettles and toasters. Happy to send the month-by-month numbers, no strings. Useful for a follow-up? A quick no is helpful too.
Sam
note: Press pitch: tie it to her own story, give one number, and offer her something usable instead of asking for coverage.

situation: 我做企业管理培训。上周给一家物流公司的HR总监周女士发了私信，推荐我们的新任主管培训课。她回复：“今年预算已经定了，明年再说吧。”
reply: 谢谢周总直接回复我，这对我很有帮助。想问一下，贵司明年大概几月开始定培训预算？我到时候再联系您，在那之前就不打扰了。
note: 对方说“不是现在”，就问清楚什么时候，记个提醒，然后真的等到那时再联系，中间不要“顺便问问”。

situation: I'm Lena Park, a sports dietitian who has worked with over 300 marathoners, and most of their fueling problems come down to one timing mistake. I want to pitch myself as a guest to Tom Reyes, who hosts a mid-size running podcast, Long Run Home; at the end of last month's episode with a 3:05 Boston runner he said he wished someone would explain race-day fueling properly, and he's booking his spring lineup.
reply:
Subject: Guest idea: why marathoners hit the wall at mile 20

Hi Tom, at the end of your episode with the Boston 3:05 runner last month, you said you wished someone would explain race-day fueling properly. I'm a sports dietitian and I've worked with over 300 marathoners on exactly that; most of their problems come down to one timing mistake. Would a 30-minute episode on it fit your spring lineup? If it's not a fit, a quick 'no' is genuinely helpful.
Lena Park, RD
note: Podcast pitch: his own words as the why-you, one line of proof, and a yes-or-no ask about the show rather than a call.

situation: I sell route-planning software to logistics companies. Emailed Ben, ops director at Northgate Freight, on Sept 15, then followed up Sept 22 with our Halden Freight case study (11% fewer miles in their first quarter), which is on our site. Nothing back. I want to send the last one.
reply: Hi Ben, last note from me on this. If route planning isn't a priority for Northgate right now, no worries at all, and I'll leave it here. If it becomes one, the Halden Freight numbers (11% fewer miles in their first quarter) will still be on our site. Door's open.
note: The final follow-up is short, carries no guilt, leaves one reason to come back later, and then you actually stop.

situation: I run a 3,000-member Slack group for indie bookshop owners. I cold-DMed Hannah, who writes the Shelf Life newsletter about bookselling, asking if she'd hear a two-line idea for a joint piece. She replied: 'Sure, what's the idea?'
reply: Thanks, Hannah. The idea: a short survey of our 3,000 members on how they price secondhand books, with the results published first in Shelf Life in November. We'd write and run the survey; you'd only need to share the link once. Interested?
note: Once they say 'go on', keep the promise you made: two lines, what it costs them, and a yes/no question.

situation: I'm Aisha Rahman, a second-year engineering student, and I want summer research experience. Professor Kenji Nakamura in the marine science department wrote a 2025 paper on low-cost temperature loggers for reef monitoring; last spring I built and calibrated a similar logger in my embedded systems class, accurate to 0.1°C in our tank tests. I've never emailed a professor cold.
reply:
Subject: Your reef temperature logger paper

Hi Professor Nakamura,
I read your 2025 paper on low-cost loggers for reef monitoring closely, because I'm a second-year engineering student and last spring I built and calibrated a similar logger for my embedded systems class, accurate to 0.1°C in our tank tests. Would you consider taking an undergraduate volunteer in your lab this summer? If there's no room, a quick no is genuinely helpful.
Best,
Aisha Rahman
note: Student to professor: prove you read their work, show one thing you've built, and ask a single yes/no question.

situation: 我是一家做宠物医院管理系统的创业公司的CTO，系统全国有1,200家诊所在用，想招一位后端负责人，年薪40万到55万。GitHub上有个开发者“林工”维护一个开源排班库，我们一直在用，他上个月修的跨时区bug正好解决了我们线上的一个问题。想在他主页留的邮箱给他发封信。
reply:
标题：你的排班库，和一个后端负责人的位置

林工你好，我们团队一直在用你维护的排班库，上个月你修的跨时区bug正好解决了我们线上的一个问题。我们做宠物医院管理系统，现在全国有1,200家诊所在用，正在找一位后端负责人，年薪40万到55万。想问一下，你最近对新机会开放吗？不考虑的话，回一句“不用”也很有帮助。
note: 招人也是冷启动私信：先证明你真用过他的东西，给一个数字和薪资范围，只问一个是或否的问题。

situation: I'm Mia Okonkwo, raising a $600k pre-seed round for an app that tracks small breweries' kegs with a $4 tag and a phone scan; the 23 breweries in our pilot cut lost kegs by 60% in four months. Angel investor Dana Whitfield backed Canlift, another brewery tool, and wrote a blog post in July calling keg loss the brewing problem nobody has solved. Canlift's founder, Tom Alvarez, said I can mention him.
reply:
Subject: Keg tracking, mentioning Tom at Canlift

Hi Dana,
Tom Alvarez at Canlift said I could mention him. Your July post called keg loss the brewing problem nobody has solved; we track every keg with a $4 tag and a phone scan. The 23 breweries in our pilot have cut lost kegs by 60% in four months. We're raising a $600k pre-seed. Would you be open to a one-page summary? A 'no' is genuinely helpful too.
Mia Okonkwo
note: Investor pitch: lead with the permitted mention, stated exactly, and her own words, one number, and ask to send a one-pager, not for a meeting.

situation: 我在“点点通”做奶茶店的小程序点单系统，上周微信联系了本地连锁茶饮“柚见”的运营负责人宋经理，她回了一句“发点资料看看吧”。我们帮“青柠茶舍”6家店用三个月把小程序订单占比从15%提到38%。
reply: 好的，宋经理。我只发一页：青柠茶舍6家店用了三个月，小程序订单占比从15%提到38%，还有收费方式，都在这页里。您看完觉得值得细聊，回个“可以”就行；不合适也直接说，一句话就够。
note: “发点资料”常是客气的推辞：只发一页，放最有说服力的那个数字，再给一个是或否的下一步。

situation: I'm Rosie Hart, a potter in Frome, and I want a two-week pop-up, 5 to 19 December, paying rent for the period. A unit at 14 Market Street has been empty since June; the letting sign names Helen Brooks at Lowther Property. Last December a 10-day pop-up I ran in a friend's café sold £6,200.
reply:
Subject: Short let for 14 Market Street this December

Hi Helen,
I noticed 14 Market Street has been empty since June. I make stoneware here in Frome and would like to rent it for a two-week pop-up, 5 to 19 December, paying rent for the period. Last December a 10-day pop-up I ran in a local café sold £6,200 of pieces. Would the landlord consider a short let like that? A quick no is genuinely useful too.
Rosie Hart
note: Asking for a space, not selling a product: show you know the unit, say exactly what and when, and ask a yes/no the agent can pass straight to the landlord.

situation: 京都で手染めの手ぬぐいを作っています。吉祥寺の雑貨店「こもれび舎」の店主、佐藤さんが先月SNSで「秋冬は贈り物向けの布ものを増やしたい」と投稿していました。うちの手ぬぐいは昨年、関西の3店舗で合わせて約1,200枚売れました。
reply:
佐藤様
突然のご連絡失礼いたします。先月の「秋冬は贈り物向けの布ものを増やしたい」という投稿を拝見し、ご連絡しました。京都で手染めの手ぬぐいを作っております。昨年は関西の3店舗で、合わせて約1,200枚お取り扱いいただきました。サンプルを3枚お送りしてもよろしいでしょうか。ご不要でしたら、その旨お返事いただけるだけでも大変ありがたいです。
note: 日本の取引先には前置き一文を添えても、依頼は小さく一つに絞る。

situation: I'm Nadia Brooks, a children's author with three picture books out; I've done 40 school visits this year with a session built around reading aloud and drawing a character together. Ms. Patel, head librarian at Oakwood Primary, wrote in the school newsletter that they're planning a Reading Week from Monday 16 to Friday 20 November and want more authors in. I've never contacted the school before.
reply:
Subject: An author visit for Reading Week?

Hi Ms. Patel,
I saw in the Oakwood newsletter that you're planning Reading Week for 16 to 20 November and hoping to bring in more authors. I write picture books, three out so far, and I've done 40 school visits this year, with a session built around reading aloud and drawing a character together. Would a visit that week be of interest? If it's not a fit, a quick no is genuinely helpful.
Best,
Nadia Brooks
note: Why them comes from her own newsletter, one number as proof, and a single yes/no question instead of a call.

situation: 我在做一个给宠物美容店用的预约工具，还没上线，想先找店主聊聊真实需求。成都一家宠物美容店'毛毛理发屋'的老板娘周姐在小红书吐槽，说周末一天能有四五个客人爽约。想私信她，但我现在没有用户，也没有案例。
reply: 周姐好，看到你那条说周末一天能有四五个客人爽约的笔记。我在做一个给宠物美容店用的预约工具，还没上线，想先弄清楚店主真正头疼的是什么。想请你回答一个问题：现在客人爽约，你们一般怎么处理？打字回我几句就行，不用打电话。不方便的话，回一句'不用'也很有帮助。
note: 没有案例就别硬凑数字：坦白说还在做调研，把请求缩小到一个打字就能回答的问题。

situation: I'm Hannah and I'm opening a café in Leeds in January. I want to buy beans from Ridgeback Roasters, a small roaster in Harrogate whose Kenyan I've loved at home for a year, but their site doesn't mention wholesale. The owner is Nick. We expect to need about 15kg a week, and I ran the coffee at Bramble Café in York for four years, around 400 cups a day.
reply:
Subject: Wholesale for a new Leeds café?

Hi Nick,
I've been drinking your Kenyan at home for a year, and it's the coffee I want behind the bar when I open a café in Leeds this January. We expect to need about 15kg a week, and I ran the coffee at Bramble Café in York for four years, around 400 cups a day. Do you take on wholesale accounts at that size? A quick no is genuinely helpful too.
Hannah
note: Buying is still a cold pitch: why them, the volume in one number, your proof, and a single yes/no question.

situation: Me llamo Lucas y toco en un grupo de folk-rock de Valencia, Los Tejados; somos cuatro y tocamos temas propios. Nuria, la programadora de la sala La Chimenea, publicó en Instagram que busca grupos locales para los jueves de noviembre. En nuestro último concierto, un martes en un bar de Russafa, metimos a 90 personas.
reply:
Asunto: Grupo local para un jueves de noviembre

Hola, Nuria:
Vi tu publicación buscando grupos locales para los jueves de noviembre. Somos Los Tejados, cuatro músicos de folk-rock de Valencia con repertorio propio. En nuestro último concierto, un martes en Russafa, metimos a 90 personas. ¿Te mando un enlace con dos temas en directo? Si no encaja, un «no» también me ayuda.

Lucas
note: La prueba es gente en la sala un martes, que es lo que le importa a quien programa.

situation: 我在杭州开了一家社区咖啡馆“拾光咖啡”，周末下午有一半座位空着，最多能坐30人，上个月办的两场手冲体验课都满员了。隔壁街“半页书店”的店主林姐在小红书上说，每月的读书会场地太小，每次只能坐12个人。我可以免费提供场地，参加的人各点一杯饮品就行。
reply: 林姐你好，看到你在小红书说读书会场地太小，每次只能坐12个人。我在隔壁街开“拾光咖啡”，周末下午最多能坐30人，也常有空位；上个月我们办的两场手冲体验课都满员了。想问问，下次读书会要不要考虑放在我们店？场地免费，参加的人各点一杯饮品就行。不合适的话，回一句“不用”也很有帮助。
note: 合作邀约先说为什么找她，再给一个数字和清楚的条件，最后只问一个是或否的问题。

situation: I'm Sam Okafor, a UX designer, and I want to do some pro bono work. Our local food bank, Eastside Pantry, signs up volunteers through a form on its website that won't submit on a phone; I tried twice this week. Their volunteer coordinator is Grace Mensah. Last year I redesigned the mobile sign-up for a youth charity, Kite Club, and their monthly sign-ups went from 40 to 110.
reply:
Subject: Your volunteer sign-up form on mobile

Hi Grace,
I tried to sign up to volunteer at Eastside Pantry from my phone this week, and the form wouldn't submit either time. I'm a UX designer and I'd like to fix it for you, for free. Last year I redesigned the mobile sign-up for Kite Club, a youth charity, and their monthly sign-ups went from 40 to 110. Would that be useful? If the timing's wrong, a quick no is genuinely helpful.
Sam Okafor
note: Offering free help is still a cold pitch: a stretched team needs to see it won't become extra work, so keep it to four lines and one yes/no.

situation: I'm Lena, a freelance English-to-German game translator. Indie studio Paper Lantern Games released its puzzle game Tidewell on Steam in August, English only, and 14 of its recent reviews are in German, several asking for a translation. Last year I localised an indie game called Mossgrove, and German-speaking players went from 3% to 11% of its sales after the German release; I want to email co-founder Ines Romero and offer a free translated sample of the first level's text.
reply:
Subject: German players asking for Tidewell in German
Hi Ines,
14 of Tidewell's recent Steam reviews are in German, and several of them ask for a translation. I'm a freelance English-to-German game translator; after I localised Mossgrove last year, German-speaking players went from 3% to 11% of its sales. Would a free German sample of the first level's text be useful to you? If it's not relevant, a 'no' is genuinely helpful.
Lena
note: The hook is evidence from their own reviews, and the ask is a free sample, not a call.

situation: 我是苏州的婚礼摄影师阿哲，今年拍了32场婚礼，其中6场在园林婚礼场地“临水园”。临水园的婚礼策划负责人许经理最近在朋友圈说，在整理明年推荐给新人的供应商名单。我想先私信问她能不能发一套我在临水园拍的样片给她看。
reply: 许经理您好，看到您在朋友圈说正在整理明年推荐给新人的供应商名单。我是苏州的婚礼摄影师阿哲，今年拍了32场婚礼，其中6场就在临水园。方便的话，我先把在临水园拍的一套样片发给您看看？不合适的话，回一句“不用”也很有帮助。
note: 想进推荐名单，先只请对方看一套在她场地拍的样片，名单的事等她看完再谈。

situation: 我叫小吴，在深圳做企业绿植租摆，公司叫“青叶绿植”，定期上门换盆和养护，科技园B栋已经有12家公司在用。楼里新搬来一家“方圆设计”，前台告诉我行政负责人是黄小姐。我今天第一次给她打电话，不想一上来就推销。
reply: 黄小姐您好，我是青叶绿植的小吴，占用您半分钟。听说方圆设计刚搬进科技园B栋，我们给这栋楼里12家公司做绿植租摆，定期上门换盆和养护。想问一下，我加您微信发一份价目表给您看看，可以吗？不需要的话直接说一声，我就不打扰了。
note: 电话陌拜要更短：先说你是谁、为什么找她、一个数字，只问能不能发资料，并让她一句话就能拒绝。

situation: I'm Ravi Menon, a site reliability engineer at a mid-size bank. Katrin Weber, who organises the Northern Ops Summit conference, posted that the call for talks closes Friday 16 October and they want more talks on incident response at regulated companies. Last year my team cut our average incident recovery time from 52 to 19 minutes, and I've given a talk on how we did it twice internally.
reply:
Subject: Talk idea: incident response at a regulated company

Hi Katrin,
You posted that you'd like more talks on incident response at regulated companies before the call for talks closes on 16 October. I'm a site reliability engineer at a mid-size bank, and last year my team cut our average incident recovery time from 52 to 19 minutes; I've given the talk on how we did it twice internally. Would that be worth submitting? If it's not a fit, a quick no is genuinely helpful.
Ravi Menon
note: Pitching a talk: the organiser's own stated gap as the why-you, one number, and a yes/no before you spend an evening on the submission.

situation: I'm Joel Haddad, a freelance accessibility auditor. Bright Sprout, an e-learning company, launched a new course player last week, and when I tested it with a screen reader the play button had no label. Their head of product is Mira Castellano, and I want to send her a LinkedIn connection request, which allows only 300 characters. Last year I audited a course platform, Learnloop, and we fixed 46 issues before its public-sector launch.
reply: Hi Mira, I tested Bright Sprout's new course player with a screen reader and the play button has no label. I'm an accessibility auditor; on Learnloop's platform we fixed 46 issues before its public-sector launch. Want my short list of what I found? A no is useful too. Joel
note: With a 300-character limit, the why-them is the bug itself; then one number and a yes/no.

situation: I'm Priya Nair and I run Brightmolar Books, a bookkeeping service for dental practices. Last week I emailed Dr. Alan Brooks at Brooks Family Dental once, using the address on the contact page of his practice's website, and I haven't added him to any mailing list. He replied: 'How did you get this address? Who gave it to you?'
reply:
Hi Dr. Brooks, fair question. I found it on the contact page of the Brooks Family Dental website; nobody passed it to me, and I haven't added you to any mailing list. If you'd rather not hear from me again, just say so and I won't write again.
Priya Nair
note: Answer the question plainly and offer the exit; don't turn the reply into a second pitch. If he says stop, reply 'Done, apologies' and remove him everywhere.

situation: Ich bin Jonas Albrecht und betreibe eine mobile Fahrradwerkstatt in Leipzig. Frau Lehmann, Personalleiterin der Softwarefirma Kranichsoft, hat auf LinkedIn geschrieben, dass inzwischen 40 Mitarbeitende mit dem Rad kommen und der neue Fahrradkeller eingeweiht ist. Im Mai habe ich bei der Druckerei Hessel an einem Tag 85 Räder direkt auf dem Firmenhof gewartet.
reply:
Betreff: Servicetag für Ihren neuen Fahrradkeller

Hallo Frau Lehmann,
Ihr Beitrag über den neuen Fahrradkeller und die 40 Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die mit dem Rad kommen, hat mich gefreut. Ich betreibe eine mobile Fahrradwerkstatt in Leipzig und warte Räder direkt vor Ort; bei der Druckerei Hessel waren es im Mai 85 Räder an einem Tag. Wäre ein Servicetag bei Kranichsoft für Sie interessant? Falls nicht, hilft mir auch ein kurzes Nein.
Viele Grüße
Jonas Albrecht
note: Der Anlass kommt aus ihrem eigenen Beitrag, dazu eine Zahl und eine Ja-oder-Nein-Frage statt eines Termins.

situation: I'm Marta Silva and I sell Tablewise, a staff scheduling tool for restaurants. Last week I cold-emailed Owen Hart, who owns three bistros, about it. He replied: 'We already use another scheduling system and we're happy with it, thanks.'
reply:
Thanks for the straight answer, Owen, that's genuinely helpful, and I'm glad it's working well for you. If that ever changes, I'm easy to find.
Marta
note: 'We're happy with what we have' is a no: thank him, leave the door open in one line, and don't ask why or when his contract renews.

situation: 我叫陈默，做办公室咖啡机租赁，公司叫“豆仓”，软件园里已经有18家公司在用。上周私信了“启明科技”的行政吴先生，他回：“这事不归我管，你找后勤的何姐，她管采购，可以说是我让你找的。”现在想加何姐微信后发第一条消息。
reply: 何姐您好，我是豆仓的陈默。启明科技行政的吴先生让我直接联系您，说办公采购归您管。我们做办公室咖啡机租赁，软件园里已经有18家公司在用。方便的话，我发一页价目表给您看看？不需要的话，回一句“不用”也很有帮助。
note: 被转介时，第一句就说清是谁让你来找她，这就是“为什么找你”；其余照旧：一个数字，一个小请求。

situation: 我叫老周，在崇明种有机番茄，现在每周给3家西餐厅供货，一共大约200公斤。在一个上海餐饮老板的微信群里，西餐厅“橄榄枝”的主厨王师傅说本地番茄品质不稳定，做冷汤酸度总是不对。我想加他微信，先免费寄5公斤样品给他试。
reply: 王师傅您好，我是群里的老周，在崇明种有机番茄。看到您在群里说本地番茄品质不稳，做冷汤酸度总对不上。我们现在每周给3家西餐厅供货，一共200公斤左右。想先免费寄5公斤给您试一锅冷汤，您看可以吗？不需要的话，回一句“不用”也很有帮助。
note: 在群里认识的人，第一句先说清是在哪看到他的话；样品免费、量小，对方说“好”或“不用”都很容易。

situation: Sou a Joana, guia de passeios a pé em Alfama, Lisboa, com nota 4,9 em 310 avaliações. O Ricardo, gerente de um hotel pequeno, a Casa do Miradouro, publicou no LinkedIn que os hóspedes estão sempre a pedir passeios 'fora do roteiro turístico'. Quero propor que o hotel recomende o meu passeio, com 10% de desconto para os hóspedes.
reply:
Assunto: Passeios fora do roteiro para os hóspedes da Casa do Miradouro

Olá Ricardo,
Vi a sua publicação sobre os hóspedes que pedem passeios fora do roteiro turístico. Sou guia de passeios a pé em Alfama e é exatamente isso que faço, com nota 4,9 em 310 avaliações. Posso oferecer 10% de desconto aos hóspedes da Casa do Miradouro. Faz sentido para o hotel? Se não fizer, um «não» também me ajuda.
Joana
note: O porquê vem da própria publicação dele; um número como prova e uma pergunta de sim ou não, sem pedir reunião.

situation: I'm Ella Novak and I run Kettle & Field, a small tea company. I'd like to license one photo by landscape photographer Tomas Lind, the misty tea terraces at dawn from his website, for the label of a new tin; the first run is 2,000 tins, and I can pay a flat €400 and credit him on every tin. Our first tin sold out its 1,500-tin run in five weeks.
reply:
Subject: Licensing your tea terraces photo for a tin label

Hi Tomas,
Your photo of the misty tea terraces at dawn is exactly the feeling I want on our next tin. I run Kettle & Field, a small tea company, and I'd like to license it for the label: a first run of 2,000 tins, a flat €400, and your name credited on every tin. Our first tin sold out its 1,500-tin run in five weeks. Would you be open to it? If not, a quick no is genuinely helpful.
Ella Novak
note: A licensing ask: name the exact image, the use, the run size and the fee up front, so the creator can answer without a call.

situation: I'm Ben Ortiz and I sell Shelfsense, shelf sensors that flag low stock for small pharmacies: £39 a month per store, sensors included, no contract, with a 30-day free trial. Last week I cold-emailed Linda Moss, who owns two independent pharmacies, and she replied with one line: 'How much is it?'
reply:
Hi Linda, thanks for asking. It's £39 a month per store, sensors included, so £78 for both pharmacies, with no contract. You can try it free for 30 days first. Would you like me to set up a trial at one of the stores? A no is genuinely fine too.
Ben
note: When they ask the price, give it in the first line with no hedging or call request, then one small yes/no next step.

situation: I'm Farah Qureshi and I make Ember Jar chilli oil, now stocked in 14 independent shops. At the Northern Fine Food Fair on Tuesday I spoke for two minutes with Greg Sutton, buyer for the nine-shop deli chain Larder & Loaf; he tried the smoked garlic one and said 'email me after the show'. I'd like to send him a sample case of six jars.
reply:
Subject: Ember Jar chilli oil, from Tuesday's fair

Hi Greg,
We spoke briefly at my stand at the Northern Fine Food Fair on Tuesday; you tried the smoked garlic chilli oil and asked me to email after the show. Ember Jar is now stocked in 14 independent shops. Could I send you a sample case of six jars for your team to try? If it's not one for Larder & Loaf, a quick no is genuinely helpful.
Farah Qureshi
note: A two-minute chat at a fair still needs reminding: the moment he asked you to write is your why-him, then one number and one small ask.

situation: I'm Tara Quinn and I run Data Drinks Sheffield, a free monthly meetup with about 60 people at each one. Dr Helen Achebe, a researcher at the local hospital trust, wrote a blog post last month on how her team cut missed appointments with a simple reminder model. I'd like to invite her to give a 20-minute talk on Thursday 19 November; it's unpaid but we cover travel, and I've never been in touch with her before.
reply:
Subject: A 20-minute talk at Data Drinks Sheffield?

Hi Dr Achebe,
Your post last month on cutting missed appointments with a simple reminder model is exactly the kind of practical work our members love. I run Data Drinks Sheffield, a free monthly meetup with about 60 people at each one. Would you consider giving a 20-minute talk on it on Thursday 19 November? It's unpaid, but we cover travel. If it's not for you, a quick no is genuinely helpful.
Tara Quinn
note: Inviting a speaker is still a cold ask: her own work as the reason, the audience size as proof, and the terms up front so she can answer without a call.
